node.title: Known budget-three path pattern is characteristic-17 isolated
node.statement: For the fixed exponent-support pattern of the known order-sixteen path witness, a 24 by 24 intersection-matrix minor has determinant alpha with absolute cyclotomic norm 2^170*17^4. Hence the pattern has full column rank in every odd characteristic except possibly 17. The known F_17 realization has rank 23, while characteristic 17 cannot support an order-2^41 domain below the official field cap. Thus this explicit finite witness cannot transport to the prize-max budget-three row with its exponent supports unchanged; no other path assignment or chamber is excluded.
